sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry the single failed Revenue Operations Analyst query for Noida, then continue starts beyond 25 and narrower pricing, fraud, planning, insights, reporting, reconciliation, and junior data-engineering variants
sourceLanes.notes: The evening public sweep used slower sequential pagination across 12 role families, four target locations, and starts 0 and 25: 96 query-location-page combinations. Ninety-five succeeded and one Noida Revenue Operations request returned HTTP 500. The 340 deduplicated results were filtered and strong candidates were inspected individually. Ten fresh listings were added: Target Data Analyst, American Express Analyst Data Analytics, SmartQ MIS, Lowe's Associate Analyst, American Express Data Governance, Wind Pioneers data internship, Nexdigm market-research trainee, Workfall BA-QA internship, HSBC Front to Back Data Control, and Gunnebo BI Analyst. The Gunnebo 3+ year role is explicitly Tier 3; duplicate Target and Wind Pioneers listing IDs were not published. The full link audit also closed Moissani, PrepClever, Training Basket, Candor Capital, and Freight Tiger after LinkedIn stopped accepting applications.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh original employee, recruiter, and founder posts using reporting, RevOps, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, referral, SQL, and Power BI variants after indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Normal LinkedIn posts were searched independently across four evening query families covering analyst and fresher roles, MIS and RevOps, junior data engineering and Data Ops, and risk, research, supply, and insights. Results were expired dated walk-ins, posts one to eight months old, senior roles, or comment and DM-gated lead-generation posts without a current employer destination. No post passed the current-original-post plus usable-route gate.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and company-hosted pages, then inspect current Paytm and Insurity analytical listings whose true seniority is not exposed on their boards
sourceLanes.notes: The evening canonicalization pass searched exact employer and ATS destinations for the new Target, American Express, SmartQ, HSBC, Gunnebo, and Lowe's roles. Search indexing did not expose a current canonical page for the exact requisitions, while each direct LinkedIn detail page remained live with Apply. No distinct ATS-only early-career role was promoted. The full audit found Synchrony's canonical analytics role returning HTTP 404, so it was archived and added to exclusions. Existing Workday, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and employer-hosted roles remain subject to the next rolling audit.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: More Cutshort API detail pagination, current YC company boards, then retry Wellfound and Instahyre with an accessible authenticated session
sourceLanes.notes: The oldest incomplete lane was resumed first. Wellfound searches resurfaced archived IDs rather than new live detail pages, Instahyre exposed only a generic resource page, Cutshort yielded no distinct new early-career role beyond existing cards, and YC Work at a Startup returned no fresh target-city listing with a verified route. The lane remains partial because authenticated Wellfound and Instahyre traversal is still inaccessible.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Additional Internshala pages for BI, MIS, research, risk, and operations analytics once direct detail access returns; then Unstop and Hirist detail pages
sourceLanes.notes: The evening specialist sweep retried Internshala, Unstop, and Hirist variants. Internshala remained blocked by robots. Unstop surfaced a Cisco Business Analyst page closing 25 Aug but labelled it for experienced professionals, while other data pages had 2025 deadlines. Hirist returned no fresh inspectable early-career detail. No listing passed all fit, freshness, and direct-route gates.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Indeed in an authenticated session or canonicalize employer destinations, then retry Foundit and Naukri client-rendered detail extraction
sourceLanes.notes: Indeed, Foundit, and Naukri were searched for current fresher and 0–2 year analyst roles. Indeed exposed a strong Rezo.ai Jr. Data Analyst discovery dated 19 Aug, but the direct apply path is account-gated and no public canonical employer destination could be found, so it was not published. The OcIT fresher listing remained in exclusions for the same route-quality failure. Foundit returned an old confidential-company training lead; Naukri and Internshala were blocked by robots.
